svg.aria-label: BGP Tracer workflow: telemetry through detectors, a shared evidence cache, PADDLE causal attribution with explicit abstention, and an impact-ranked operator review queue
svg.text: BGP Tracer: Joint Routing–Traffic Causal Attribution for Alert Prioritisation
Deterministic triage · PADDLE attribution · auditable, impact-ranked incidents
no LLM calls · ≈60 s per window · deterministic and replayable
the baseline adapts, the AS does not
a structured argument, never a verdict
A detector that did not run is recorded as suspended, with a reason — never as a negative observation.
Baseline selection governs the traffic detector; the routing detectors use their own baselines (validated RPKI ROA, per-prefix withdrawal rate).
decouples the two phases · a verdict is a lookup, not a re-run
Sections: config · traffic · routing · diagnosis · evidence · report · meta · validation
a later stage cannot replace it
one estimator · abstains when the evidence does not justify a claim
d = median(O) / median(E) · O = now, E = then
control plane vs. the same clock
the null is an ordinary day, at the same clock
a claim is admitted only if all pass
silence is a measurement; absence is not
The estimator is one. It is not a vote among channels, and it does not fall back to an older method when it abstains.
A channel that was not instrumented is missing metadata; a channel that went silent during the incident is evidence.
ranked by measured impact, not by raw alert frequency
